process_area.title: People Analytics, Workforce Planning & HR Technology

value_stream.name: HR Shared Services, Employee Experience & People Analytics

fields.Participants: People Analytics Manager, HRBP, Store Ops (links to VS-07), Finance (links to VS-17.4), Strategic Planning (links to VS-33.1)
fields.Trigger: Annual plan (links to VS-33.1); growth/new stores; restructure

workflows.name: Workforce Planning, Headcount Forecasting & Capacity Planning

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "headcount by entity/function/location, demand drivers" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "People Analytics Manager/Finance forecast headcount and labor cost under" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "track actual vs plan, flag gaps" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-540 (ensure controlled execution — People Analytics, Workforce Planning & HR Technology (PA-103.3).)
- operational: scenario planning and budget reconciliation; operational: driver-based demand modeling
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-hire risk**: Forecast too high inflates labor cost; mitigated by scenario planning and budget reconciliation
- **Under-staff risk**: Under-forecast harms service/overtime; mitigated by driver-based demand modeling
System Touchpoints: - Workforce-planning tool; HRIS (links to VS-29.2); FP&A (links to VS-17.4); WFM (links to VS-19.3)

steps.activity: People Analytics Manager/HRBP build the workforce plan: current-state headcount by entity/function/location, demand drivers (sales growth, new stores per VS-37, store closures per VS-59, automation), and gap analysis to future-state needs

People Analytics Manager/Finance forecast headcount and labor cost under scenarios, reconcile to the labor budget (links to VS-33.1/VS-102 W3327), and identify build/buy/redeploy actions; coordinate store staffing model (29/store per profile §12.1, links to VS-19.3 WFM)

People Analytics Manager/HRBP track actual vs plan, flag gaps (over/under-staffing by location), and feed to recruitment (links to VS-19.1) and WFM (links to VS-19.3); report to leadership (links to VS-33.2)

fields.Participants: People Analytics Manager, Talent Acquisition (links to VS-19.1), HRBP, Finance (links to VS-17.4)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-measure of "measure recruitment funnel" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-identify of "People Analytics Manager/Talent Acquisition identify bottlenecks" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report recruitment KPIs to CHRO and hiring managers, benchmark to industry, and…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-123 (ensure HR service delivery & people-data accuracy.)
- operational: funnel analytics and pipeline; operational: source analytics
Pain Points / Risks: - **Slow-time-to-fill risk**: Vacancies harm operations (stores/DC); mitigated by funnel analytics and pipeline
- **Poor-source risk**: Ineffective sourcing channels waste budget; mitigated by source analytics
System Touchpoints: - ATS/recruitment analytics (links to VS-19.1); BI (links to VS-28.1); finance (links to VS-17.4)

steps.activity: People Analytics Manager measure recruitment funnel: applications, screened, interviewed, offered, accepted, hired, by source/role/location; compute time-to-fill, cost-per-hire, offer-acceptance rate, quality-of-hire

People Analytics Manager/Talent Acquisition identify bottlenecks (slow sourcing, interview bottlenecks, low acceptance), source effectiveness, and diversity of pipeline (links to W3343); recommend sourcing/process improvements
People Analytics Manager report recruitment KPIs to CHRO and hiring managers, benchmark to industry, and feed workforce plan (W3345) and budget (W3327)

fields.Participants: People Analytics Manager, HRBP, C&B (links to VS-102), EX (links to VS-103.2), CHRO

workflows.name: Turnover/Attrition Analytics, Retention Risk & Exit Insight

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "People Analytics Manager measure turnover" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-track of "track impact, and report to leadership" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-540 (ensure controlled execution — People Analytics, Workforce Planning & HR Technology (PA-103.3).)
- operational: retention-risk model and proactive action; operational: exit analysis and analytics
Pain Points / Risks: - **Regrettable-loss risk**: Losing high performers/key talent; mitigated by retention-risk model and proactive action
- **Hidden-driver risk**: Surface turnover without root cause; mitigated by exit analysis and analytics
System Touchpoints: - People analytics/HRIS (links to VS-29.2); exit survey (links to VS-19.5); BI (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: People Analytics Manager measure turnover: overall, voluntary/involuntary, regrettable, by tenure/role/location/entity/manager; compute retention curves and identify hotspots

People Analytics Manager conduct exit analysis: exit-interview themes (links to VS-19.5), drivers (pay links to VS-102, manager, growth, workload), and regrettable-loss patterns; build retention-risk model for high performers/key roles

People Analytics Manager/HRBP build retention action plans for hotspots (manager coaching links to VS-19.4, rewards links to VS-102, EX links to VS-103.2), track impact, and report to leadership (links to VS-33.2)

fields.Participants: People Analytics Manager, C&B (links to VS-102), EX/DEI (links to W3343), ESG (links to VS-25.2), Legal (links to VS-100)
fields.Trigger: Annual; ESG/reporting cycle (links to VS-25.2); complements VS-102 W3309

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "compile workforce composition" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-flag of "People Analytics Manager integrate pay-equity analysis" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-generate of "prepare diversity and pay-equity disclosures for ESG/sustainability reporting" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-123 (ensure HR service delivery & people-data accuracy.)
- operational: data discipline; operational: anonymization and controls
Pain Points / Risks: - **Disclosure-risk**: Incomplete/inaccurate disclosure harms reputation; mitigated by data discipline
- **Privacy risk**: Sensitive demographic data (links to VS-91); mitigated by anonymization and controls
System Touchpoints: - People analytics (links to VS-28.1); pay equity (links to VS-102); ESG reporting (links to VS-25.2); privacy (links to VS-91)

steps.activity: People Analytics Manager compile workforce composition: gender, age, PWD, indigenous/minority representation, by role/level/entity; identify under-representation and barriers
People Analytics Manager integrate pay-equity analysis (links to VS-102 W3309), promotion-equity, and representation in hiring pipeline (links to W3346) into a holistic equity view; flag risks

People Analytics Manager/Legal prepare diversity and pay-equity disclosures for ESG/sustainability reporting (links to VS-25.2) and board (links to VS-36), under privacy controls (links to VS-91), and track progress vs targets

fields.Participants: People Analytics Manager, BI (links to VS-28.1), CHRO, Leadership
fields.Trigger: Monthly executive cycle; board reporting (links to VS-36.1)

workflows.name: HR Dashboard, Scorecard & Executive People Report Operations

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "headcount, turnover, time-to-fill, engagement, diversity/equity, learning, safety" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "review with HR leadership and entity HR" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to executive committee and board" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-123 (ensure HR service delivery & people-data accuracy.)
- operational: outcome-oriented KPIs; operational: near-real-time BI (links to VS-28)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Metric-silo risk**: Dashboard optimized for activity not outcome; mitigated by outcome-oriented KPIs
- **Stale-data risk**: Late data misleads decisions; mitigated by near-real-time BI (links to VS-28.1)
System Touchpoints: - BI/dashboard (links to VS-28.1); people analytics; board reporting (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: People Analytics Manager/BI maintain the HR dashboard and scorecard: headcount, turnover, time-to-fill, engagement, diversity/equity, learning, safety (links to VS-24/VS-83), labor cost — vs plan and benchmark
People Analytics Manager/CHRO analyze trends and outliers, build narratives and recommendations, and review with HR leadership and entity HR
CHRO/People Analytics Manager present the people report to executive committee and board (links to VS-33.2/VS-36.1): workforce health, risks (links to VS-21.2), DEI progress, and strategic actions

fields.Participants: People Analytics Manager, Master Data (links to VS-29), Data Governance (links to VS-28.2), IT (links to VS-27), Data Privacy (links to VS-91)

workflows.name: HR Data Governance, Integration & People-Data Quality

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitor HR data quality" (replaces manual Step 2).
Controls: - CTL-540 (ensure controlled execution — People Analytics, Workforce Planning & HR Technology (PA-103.3).)
- operational: governance and validation; operational: privacy-by-design and controls
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-quality risk**: Bad people-data corrupt analytics and payroll; mitigated by governance and validation
- **Privacy risk**: People-data mishandled (links to VS-91); mitigated by privacy-by-design and controls
System Touchpoints: - HRIS/master data (links to VS-29.2); data governance (links to VS-28.2); privacy (links to VS-91); IT integrations (links to VS-27)

steps.activity: People Analytics Manager/Master Data govern HR master data (employee, job, org, position links to VS-29.2): data ownership, quality rules, validation, and stewardship; integrate with payroll (VS-19.2), time (VS-19.3), and benefits (VS-102)

People Analytics Manager/Data Governance monitor HR data quality (completeness, accuracy, timeliness), resolve exceptions, and manage integrations (HRIS ↔ payroll ↔ BI ↔ master data) with IT (links to VS-27)

People Analytics Manager/Data Privacy ensure people-data handling per Data Privacy Act (links to VS-91): purpose limitation, access control, retention (links to VS-88), DSAR (links to VS-91.1), and breach response (links to VS-91.3)

fields.Participants: HR Technology Mgr, IT (links to VS-27), ITAM (links to VS-99), Vendors, HR functions
fields.Trigger: System change; release; integration; complements VS-27/VS-99

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "administer the HRIS/Core-HR platform" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-test of "test and deploy changes" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report platform health and adoption to CHRO/IT" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-540 (ensure controlled execution — People Analytics, Workforce Planning & HR Technology (PA-103.3).)
- operational: change discipline (links to VS-27); operational: monitoring and testing
Pain Points / Risks: - **Config-debt risk**: Unmanaged config creates instability and upgrade risk; mitigated by change discipline (links to VS-27.1)
- **Integration-break risk**: Integration failures disrupt payroll/benefits; mitigated by monitoring and testing
System Touchpoints: - HRIS/Core-HR; IT service (links to VS-27); ITAM/licenses (links to VS-99.2); master data (links to VS-29.2)

steps.activity: HR Technology Mgr administer the HRIS/Core-HR platform: configuration (org structure, jobs, workflows, rules), security/roles (links to VS-27.3), and master-data setup (links to VS-29.2); manage vendor relationship and licensing (links to VS-99.2)

HR Technology Mgr/IT manage releases/enhancements (links to VS-27.1 change), integrations (payroll VS-19.2, benefits VS-102, BI VS-28, master data VS-29), and incident/problem management (links to VS-27.1); test and deploy changes
HR Technology Mgr drive HR technology roadmap (links to VS-30 innovation, VS-103.3 analytics), evaluate new modules/automation (W3352), and report platform health and adoption to CHRO/IT

fields.Participants: HRSS Mgr, HR functions, Innovation/Automation (links to VS-30.2), People Analytics (links to VS-103.3), Internal Audit (links to VS-21.1)
fields.Trigger: Process pain point; automation opportunity; complements VS-30

workflows.name: HR Process Excellence, Automation & Continuous Improvement

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "HRSS Mgr map and baseline HR processes" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-report of "report HR operational excellence to CHRO" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-540 (ensure controlled execution — People Analytics, Workforce Planning & HR Technology (PA-103.3).)
- operational: change management; operational: audit and control review (links to VS-21)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Automation-without-adoption risk**: Tech deployed but unused; mitigated by change management
- **Control-erosion risk**: Process changes weaken controls; mitigated by audit and control review (links to VS-21.1)
System Touchpoints: - Process/automation tools (links to VS-30.2); HRIS (links to VS-29.2); analytics (links to VS-28.1); audit (links to VS-21.1)

steps.activity: HRSS Mgr map and baseline HR processes (recruitment, onboarding, payroll support, benefits, lifecycle, service center), identify waste/friction (case trends links to W3336, feedback links to W3342), and prioritize improvements

HRSS Mgr/Automation (links to VS-30.2) implement improvements: standardization, automation/RPA (offer letters, verifications, data entry), self-service expansion (W3330), and AI-assist (knowledge base, chatbot); manage change and adoption
HRSS Mgr measure improvement impact (cycle time, cost, error rate, CSAT links to W3336), sustain gains with controls/audit (links to VS-21.1), and report HR operational excellence to CHRO
